title: Necessary Conditions for Single-Critical-Point Higher-Order Szegő Sum Rules in OPUC
summary: We prove the necessity part of the higher-order Szegő theorem on the unit circle for the single-critical-point weights $H_m(e^{iθ})=(1-\cosθ)^m$, $m\ge1$. If $\{α_n\}_{n\ge0}$ are the Verblunsky coefficients of a nontrivial probability measure $dμ=w(θ)dθ/(2π)+dμ_{\mathrm s}$, then the weighted Szegő condition $\int_0^{2π} (1-\cosθ)^m\log w(θ)\frac{dθ}{2π}>-\infty$ implies $Δ^mα\in\ell^2, \,\, α\in\ell^{2m+2}.$ The proof uses a finite-volume version of Yan's higher-order sum rule.
